[[{{PAGENAME}}]] is the cook of the [[Refugee camp]]. She is the first new refugee to show up, once an additional tent has been built by the player and a new refugee has been summoned. Through conversation with her, you receive the task of building the refugees a proper [[GoC Cooking table|kitchen]].

==Quests==
She first asks you to build a [[Camp kitchen|kitchen]] at the [[Refugee camp|camp]], so that she does not get bored and sad. This quest unlocks the ability to trade with her, but '''only''' the first two tiers are unlocked.

The next assignment is to improve the [[GoC Cooking table|kitchen]], so it feels more like home to her. With it, you gain the ability to build [[Cooking table II|kitchen II]].

After you built the [[Cooking table II|kitchen II]] and spoke with her about it, she'll ask you to construct [[Bee hive|Beehive]]<nowiki/>s to sweeten the taste of the foods. (Only need to build 2 of the 3 to complete the quest) After finishing this quest, she gives you 3 recipes ({{Item|Recipe In Lentil We Trust}}, {{Item|Recipe Vegetable set}}, {{Item|Honey cake}}) and unlocks the tier III trade option.
